source_packets.pressure: Uncertainty highlighting in generative AI search makes people less willing to trust and share results whether confidence is high or low, which pressures DelayBasin to treat confidence labels and caution surfaces as active intervention surfaces rather than harmless honesty.

Search-engine warning banners are rare, inconsistent, and can disappear while result quality stays largely unchanged, which pressures DelayBasin to isolate warning surfaces from the underlying evidence itself.

Source-reputation warning banners can significantly decrease trust in accurate information, which pressures DelayBasin to preserve warning-hidden controls before reading caution chrome as neutral safety context.
Trust in warning labels varies with label design, which pressures DelayBasin to treat banner form and confidence strips as live design levers rather than transparent notes.
